answer: What stops the farm is not the saffron alone but the sonnet behind it and the voyage that survives every appeal. You cannot borrow Flint rivetmaker licence with rivetmakers attestation from a neighbour; a licence rivetmakers renew after head audits. A single rivetmaker spends 4 years and 4000 head examinations to earn it; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand times. One real deed beats a thousand fake claims.
